text:
Alex: heads up — nightly CI flagged a small-batch p95 latency regression (~+12%) on the 3am run. CI-bot posted a failure in the run details: <https://ci.internal/runs/2443123456|run/2443123456> :eyes:

CI-bot: nightly-small-batch: p95=310ms (+12% vs baseline). Logs + artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/2443123456 :warning:

Maya: on it, grabbing the log bundle now. Any quick guesses? recent infra change? :thinking_face:

Sam: not from infra side afaik. I pushed the small-batch scheduling tweak last week but it was feature-flagged; could still affect binpacking. Will pull the config used for that run.

Alex: single-run metadata shows config=small-batch-optimized, kernel=5.15, runtime-commit=ae4b2f. No obvious spike in CPU, but queue wait time jumped.

Jordan: can someone repro locally with the nightly seed? Try:```bash
./bench/run_smallbatch.sh --model gpt-small --seq 256 --iters 100 --seed nightly --collect-profiles
```
That will produce `perf.data` and `kvcache_trace.json`.

Maya: repro started on my workstation. Attaching quick tail of the server log showing tail latencies:```
[00:02:12] request_id=... p95_ms=312
[00:02:13] request_id=... p95_ms=318
[00:02:14] request_id=... p95_ms=305
```
Seems tail not catastrophic but shifted.

Sam: I pulled the scheduling patch diff — two lines in scheduler that change batch coalescing timeout from 5ms -> 8ms. Could increase head-of-line wait. Reverting locally now to test.

Tess: if coalescing increased, that would fit queue wait increase. Also check KV cache hit-rate — a lower hit-rate can inflate p95. Jordan, can you run with `--kvcache-debug`?

Jordan: kicked off repro with `--kvcache-debug` and nvprof capture. If someone can run a bisect on the scheduler flag quickly that'd be great.

CI-bot: triggered job: eng-runtime/nightly/small-batch/regression-bisect (queued).

Maya: repro confirms higher queue wait when scheduler timeout=8ms. Patch revert drops p95 back to baseline locally.

Alex: nice catch. Plan: roll a quick revert for scheduler flag in canary, monitor tonight's run. @Sam can you open the PR and add a test that asserts coalescing timeout effect in the microbench? Keep canary on for 24h.

Sam: will open PR in 10m, adding a microbench and a short note in the changelog.

Tess: left a note in the perf dashboard about the regression and linked the run. Also setting an alert to watch queue_wait metric.

Alex: thanks everyone. If canary looks good we'll merge revert and schedule a proper fix (maybe adaptive timeout). Marking this thread resolved for now. :heavy_check_mark:
